name: C4Script
comment: Only comments and strings: VS Code needs them to skip brackets inside for bracket matching and pair colors, and to not auto-close inside them. All other colors come from the language server's semantic tokens.

comment-block.comment: an unterminated block comment runs to the end of the file, like in the engine
comment-block.name: comment.block.c4script

string.comment: strings end at the line end when unterminated; the engine knows only the escapes \" and \\
string.name: string.quoted.double.c4script
